rendered.body:
Hi Graza team,

We’re a small Instagram content studio dedicated to bringing the joy of culinary experiences to your audience. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you, built around the fact that Graza started Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) but also made sure to get into grocers like Whole Foods, Target, etc [P8]. You’ve described your social content, product design, and messaging as playful and culinary-inspired, rather than overly formal, which aligns with your approach [P7]. Graza's playful and creative social content has grown to have around 2,000 new social followers since launching the cans, a testament to your engaging and authentic approach. We envision a post that showcases your playful and creative approach, building on the first fact by featuring a visually appealing slide or carousel showcasing your playful and culinary-inspired messaging, paired with a call to action that invites your audience to share their own experiences with Graza. It would be a fun way to continue your storytelling and engage with your community.

The BrandPilot team
